text: Casein is dissolved in alkali, pushed through spinnerets into an acid bath where it sets as filaments, then made insoluble with formaldehyde.

steps.name: dissolve
steps.note: The casein is taken into solution by alkali, a liquid ready to be spun.

steps.name: spin
steps.note: The liquid is pushed through spinnerets, small nozzles, into an acid bath, where it sets as filaments.
The filaments are hardened in a bath of common salt or other salts.
The fibres are hardened in formaldehyde, so they no longer dissolve in water.
